Windows Systems Engineer (WSA Team)
The Windows Systems Administration (WSA) team runs the Windows infrastructure behind eMAG Group. We own Active Directory, Exchange, SQL Server, virtualization, backup, endpoint management and identity automation for the entire group.
We are looking for a Windows Systems Engineer to keep our server, messaging, database and endpoint platforms stable, secure and automated. You will troubleshoot production issues, automate repetitive work with PowerShell, manage Windows and macOS endpoints through ManageEngine Endpoint Central, and maintain identity workflows in Adaxes.
 What you’ll have to do:
Administer, monitor and troubleshoot Windows Server environments and core roles (AD DS, DNS, DHCP, GPO, File Services, IIS).
Manage Exchange Server (on-premises) and Exchange Online, including mail flow and hybrid configuration.
Operate SQL Server instances: availability, backups and performance troubleshooting.
Manage Windows and macOS endpoints with an MDM platform: software deployment, patch management, configuration profiles, compliance and inventory.
Build and maintain identity and access automation with an Active Directory management tool: user lifecycle (onboarding, changes, offboarding), group membership rules and scheduled tasks.
Write and maintain PowerShell scripts for deployments, reporting and routine operations.
Maintain virtualization (Hyper-V, oVirt, OpenStack) and failover clustering platforms.
Run backup and restore processes and test recovery regularly.
Apply security hardening and support compliance requirements.
Handle tickets and incidents in Jira, document solutions in Confluence and monitor services with Zabbix and Grafana.
Keep servers patched, making sure security and performance updates are applied on time.
Develop and implement procedures for deployment, application updates, backup and maintenance processes.
 What makes you a good fit:
Windows Server:solid understanding of Windows Server and its roles, with the ability to troubleshoot issues independently, up to complex infrastructure problems.
Active Directory and Exchange:AD user, group and policy administration; experience with Exchange on-premises and Exchange Online. SQL Server:working knowledge of backups, permissions and maintenance.
Endpoint management:experience with any MDM tool: software deployment, patch policies, configuration profiles and compliance for Windows and macOS.
Identity automation:experience with an Active Directory management tool: business rules, scheduled tasks and user lifecycle automation.
Scripting:PowerShell for deployments and automation; Bash or Python is a plus.
Virtualization and clustering:Hyper-V, oVirt or OpenStack, and failover clustering.
Backup:knowledge of backup solutions and restore procedures.
Cloud:Azure and Microsoft 365 configuration and monitoring, including Entra ID,following best practices.
Monitoring and ticketing:Jira, Confluence, Zabbix, Grafana or equivalent tools.
Security:experience with security hardening and compliance standards.
AI tools:practical experience using AI assistants (e.g. Claude, Copilot) for scripting,troubleshooting and documentation, with the judgment to validate their output and an understanding of data security when using them. 
 What makes you stand out: 
Experience designing and implementing complex, multi-site solutions at architecture level.
Deep knowledge of cloud technologies (Azure, hybrid identity, Intune or other MDM platforms).
Microsoft certifications (e.g. AZ-104, AZ-800/801, MS-102).
Experience with macOS management and Apple deployment programs.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Git.
 What we’ve prepared for you:

A flexible budget that you can invest in yourself as you wish: meal tickets, holiday tickets, cultural vouchers, private pension, foreign language classes, eMAG, Fashion Days, Therme & Genius, membership to different gyms or even professional development classes. 
Different discounts from our partners: banking, mobile, dental medicine or wellness. 
Access to the Bookster library and free credits on the Hilio psycho-emotional health platform. 
An accelerated learning environment, with access to over 100.000 curated online resources and platforms, learning academies and development programs. 
New headquarters, where sleek design, natural light, and versatile spaces create an energizing and comfortable environment for hybrid work. 
 Curious to find out more about the next step in your career? Apply now and if your experience is relevant for the role you wish, we will give you a call for more details! Also, here you can find our confidentiality policy if you want to consult it.
